text:
Ilya Mikheyev is a fast, honest, undrafted winger on his fourth NHL team, and Tampa Bay has slotted him into a middle-six job at about 15 minutes a night. Four goals and seven points in 17 games is about what that job should produce, and two of the goals came in one night against Chicago, his old team, as the Lightning won their eighth straight at home.

His finishing is running a bit hot, four goals on 2.42 expected (the quality of his chances), so expect a cooler stretch. The rest of the profile is steady. Tampa has 53% of the expected goals with him on the ice at five on five, though slightly less than when he sits. Evolving-Hockey had him a little above replacement last season in Chicago, with the context that he played beside weak teammates against strong competition. On a better team, with less asked of him, he's useful: he skates, forechecks and chips in. Our range has him around 17 goals by season's end.
